content.title: Where to Celebrate 2026 Opening Day - Cincinnati Magazine
content.text: The annual Findlay Market Opening Day Parade takes off at noon on Thursday, March 26.Photograph courtesy Findlay Market ParadeOpening Day in the Cov Street PartyCovington is getting the party started at the crack of dawn and going hard until the sun goes down at this street festival with live radio broadcasts, bands, DJs, beer, Smoke Justis barbecue, and much more. Bob & Tom will be broadcasting live from 6-10 a.m. and from noon-3 p.m. you can catch the ESPN 1530 broadcast with Tony Pike, Austin Elmore, and Mo Egger. 6 a.m.-10 p.m., Court St. & Park St., CovingtonOpening Day at RhinegeistThe OTR brewery is starting bright and early at 8:30 a.m. with breakfast sandwiches, drink specials, family friendly games, and exclusive merch. You’ll be able to get in a full party and still have plenty of time to make it to the parade to see the brewery team’s float. 8:30-10 a.m., Rhinegeist Brewery, 1910 Elm St., Over-the-RhineOpening Day Block Party at Court StreetThe businesses of Court Street Plaza are coming together to host an Opening Day party with exclusive drink and food specials, DJs, parade views, inflatables, cornhole, and yard games all day long. 10 a.m.-4 p.m., Court Street Plaza, downtownOpening Day Celebration at Washington ParkOscar Mayer is hosting a party with some of the best parade views in town—and offering free hot dogs from the iconic Weinermobile. In addition to complimentary meat, there’ll be live music, inflatable baseball games, local vendors and food trucks, family activities, and giant yard games. 10 a.m.-4 p.m., Washington Park, 1230 Elm St., Over-the-RhineFindlay Market Opening Day ParadeIt’s not Opening Day without the famous Opening Day Parade. Grand Marshall Jeff “The Cowboy” Brantley will be heading the march from Findlay Market, down Race Street, along Fifth St. by Fountain Square, and ending by the Taft Theater. The parade lasts around two hours so plan your downtown driving accordingly. noon-2 p.m., Over-the-Rhine and downtownJonJon and Friends Opening Day BashThe newly renamed Cincinnati Lager House is hosting one of the city’s biggest Opening Day parties with Kiss 107’s JonJon and friends. The radio personality will be doing a live broadcast from the celebration alongside games, food, beer, and DJs. Tickets for the noon-4 p.m. VIP party are $40 and include a buffet, three drink tickets, Fest Tent access, and cocktails by Molly Wellmann. Once the game starts, party entry is free. noon-8 p.m., Cincinnati Lager House, 115 Joe Nuxhall Way, downtownReds Opening Day On The LeveeNewport on the Levee will be transformed into a giant watch party with the game on the big screens, food and drink specials, a live DJ, and a ceremonial first pitch thrown by a special guest. For those stopping at the Levee before heading the the game, Beeline is offering 50% off your tab when you show your tickets. 2 p.m., Newport on the Levee, One Levee Way, Newport
